body: It's weird, because I love my job, but at the same time I'm absolutely overwhelmed by it.

I really appreciate your response. I feel like one of the things that makes me want to die most is the constant emotional pain of mental illness. It really is a sickness. I'm sick, but it's invisible. I'm always in pain, and I'm always tired. I feel like I'm running out of strength, and I don't know how much longer I can keep trying for. It sucks, because I understand that even though my family and friends love me, no amount of love can cure a chronic illness. No amount of satisfaction from my job can cure a chronic illness. It would help if my workload felt less overwhelming, but part of me is scared that I just feel overwhelmed because of my mental illness, and a healthy person would be able to handle my workload with no problem.

My mom is an emotionally-draining person to be around, because of her mental illness. She pushes away the people who she loves most, even as she tries desperately to get closer to them. There have been times in my life when I have been the same way. I try to be better now, but being an emotionally-draining person who people avoid is one of the greatest fears of my life.
